title: AI Services for Azure Developers
description: Integrate Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, AI Search, and vision/language/speech APIs into applications.
longDescription: This module teaches Azure AI services for developers. You will learn how to use Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI Service, build RAG architectures with AI Search, integrate vision, language, and speech APIs, and secure AI workloads with managed identities.
whatYouLearn: Choose the right Azure AI service for a task
Call Azure OpenAI chat and completion models
Build RAG architectures with AI Search and embeddings
Use vision, language, and speech APIs in applications
Secure AI service access with managed identities
Integrate AI services into web and worker applications
